title: Mechatronics
description: Introduction to mechatronic systems; modeling of mixed mechatronic systems; microcontroller programming and interfacing; theory, selection and implementation of sensors and actuators commonly used in mechatronic systems; control architectures and case studies in mechatronics systems.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of MECH 554, MECH 458, MECH 580 (if taken in the same topic).
A combined undergraduate and graduate course.
